stories.title: Probably Stolen reaches a 112,145-player peak on Steam
paragraphs: Nerdly reports that Probably Stolen, a cyberpunk shopkeeper simulation, peaked at 112,145 concurrent Steam players during its launch week.

That is a striking audience for an indie simulation built around running a shop in a cyberpunk setting. The saved evidence establishes launch-week attention, but not sales, long-term retention, or how the game compares with its developer's past releases.

scoreNotes.general: A new indie release drew an unusually large launch-week audience, making it a useful signal of player demand for compact simulation games.
scoreNotes.heat: The reported Steam peak exceeds 112,000 concurrent players, a substantial audience for an indie shopkeeping simulation.
scoreNotes.time: Nerdly's report is dated October 30, outside the 24-hour fresh window but within the seven-day fallback period.
scoreNotes.ethos: The exact peak is reported by Nerdly in the saved search results; no independent player-count source was verified in this run.
